heading: How a Bio-Gaz biodigester works.
intro: A simple, robust system suited to the tropical climate — built to run for decades with minimal upkeep.

steps.title: 1. Collection
steps.description: Animal manure, crop residue and household waste are gathered on site.

steps.title: 2. Loading
steps.description: The water/organic mix is fed into the dome fermentation chamber.

steps.title: 3. Fermentation
steps.description: Anaerobically, bacteria break down matter and produce biogas over 40–60 days.

steps.title: 4. Biogas
steps.description: Gas is piped to a stove for cooking, replacing charcoal and firewood.

steps.title: 5. Digestate
steps.description: The liquid and solid residue becomes the Agri-Shell biofertilizer.
